# Runtime tools

19 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `get_game_state`

Get the current game state: running/paused, active scene, FPS, time scale

Takes no parameters.

## `inspect_node_at_runtime`

Get full property snapshot of a node (current values, not just schema)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Node path in the active scene |
| `include_children` | `boolean` | — | Include immediate children info (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-06:

```json

  "node_path": "/root"
}
```

## `record_gameplay`

Record gameplay input events for a duration (game must be running)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `duration` | `number` | — | Recording duration in seconds (default: 5, max: 60) |
| `include_snapshots` | `boolean` | — | Include periodic performance snapshots (default: false) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-17:

```json
{
  "duration": 1
}
```

## `replay_gameplay`

Replay a previously recorded gameplay session (game must be running)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `events` | `array` | yes | Events array from record_gameplay |
| `speed_scale` | `number` | — | Speed multiplier for delays (default: 1.0) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-18:

```json
{
  "events": "$GP_EVENTS"
}
```

## `click_ui_element`

Simulate a click on a UI Control node (calls press() for buttons or emits gui_input)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the Control node to click |
| `method` | `string` | — | Interaction method (default: press) One of: `"press"`, `"toggle"`, `"gui_input"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-15:

```json
{
  "node_path": "/root/RuntimeRoot/TestBtn"
}
```

## `set_game_speed`

Set Engine.time_scale to speed up or slow down the game (1.0 = normal)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `time_scale` | `number` | yes | Speed multiplier. 0 = freeze, 0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double speed |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-04a:

```json
{
  "time_scale": 0.5
}
```

## `call_function`

## `listen_to_signal`

Wait for a signal to fire on a node (async, with timeout)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Node path |
| `signal_name` | `string` | yes | Signal to wait for |
| `timeout` | `number` | — | Max seconds to wait before giving up (default: 5) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/07-runtime.json`, test R-13:

```json

  "node_path": "/root",
  "signal_name": "child_entered_tree",
  "timeout": 2
}
```
